result.instructions: Tools for WuBook, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rooms are available from 12 to 15 November?"; "Show today's arrivals and departures."; "What is the reservation XY-0123 and how much has been paid?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WuBook data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wubook_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wubook_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wubook_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. wubook_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wubook_list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms
tools.description: List the physical rooms of the property (id, room type id, name, tags). POST /kp/property/fetch_rooms.

tools.name: wubook_list_room_types
tools.title: List room types
tools.description: List the room types (id, name, short name, default price, default occupancy). POST /kp/property/fetch_room_types.

tools.name: wubook_list_rates
tools.title: List rates
tools.description: List the rates of the property (id, name, board, currency, standard flag). Use a rate id for prices and restrictions. POST /kp/property/fetch_rates.

tools.name: wubook_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products (a room type sold on a board basis: id, room type id, name, default price, occupancy). Product ids are the keys of prices and availability. POST /kp/property/fetch_products.

tools.name: wubook_list_meal_boards
tools.title: List meal boards
tools.description: List the meal rules and meal prices per board type (fb, hb, bb, ai) for adults, teens, children and babies. POST /kp/property/fetch_meals_board.

tools.name: wubook_list_extras
tools.title: List extras
tools.description: List the extras the property sells (id, name, price, VAT percentage, cost, tags). POST /kp/property/fetch_extras.

tools.name: wubook_get_inventory_symbols
tools.title: Get inventory symbols
tools.description: The meaning of the short keys in prices and restrictions (p price, a availability, m MinStay, M MaxStay, c closure, ...). POST /kp/inventory/fetch_symbols.

tools.name: wubook_get_room_availability
tools.title: Get room availability
tools.description: Availability for a stay: for each room type id, the number of rooms available and the ids of the available physical rooms. The availability count can be lower than the number of listed physical rooms when a reservation has no physical room assigned yet; use the availability count when assessing bookable capacity. POST /kp/inventory/fetch_rooms_availability.

tools.name: wubook_get_rate_values
tools.title: Get rate values
tools.description: Daily prices, availability and restrictions of one rate, starting at a date: for each product id a list with one object per day (p price, a availability, m/M min/max stay, c closed, ...; see wubook_get_inventory_symbols). POST /kp/inventory/fetch_rate_values.

tools.name: wubook_update_inventory
tools.title: Update prices, availability and restrictions
tools.description: WRITE: overwrite daily prices, availability and stay restrictions of one rate. `products` maps a product id to a list of day objects; the first object is the day `from`, the next the following day, and so on. Only the fields you send per day change. Changes can be pushed to connected channels (OTAs) and affect live bookings, so confirm the values with the user first. POST /kp/inventory/write.

from.description: First day the lists start at, yyyy-mm-dd.

c.description: 1 = closed for sale on this day.

nt.description: 1 = no OTA reservations on this day.

products.description: Product id → one object per day, e.g. {"12": [{"p": 90, "a": 3}, {"p": 95}]}. Keys: p price, a availability, m/M min/max stay, ma/Ma by arrival, ni no check-in, no no check-out, c closed, nt no OTA, mx/Mx advance, o overbooking, l max OTA.

tools.name: wubook_get_reservation
tools.title: Get reservation
tools.description: One reservation by id or by reservation code (XY-0001): status, booker customer id, origin channel, board, dates, price split (rooms, extras, meals), payment, taxes and rooms with occupancy and customer ids. POST /kp/reservations/fetch_one_reservation.

tools.name: wubook_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations, optionally filtered by creation, arrival or departure date ranges (inclusive). Newest first is not guaranteed; page with offset. Returns the page plus next_offset (null when the last page was reached). POST /kp/reservations/fetch_reservations.

created_from.description: Created on or after (yyyy-mm-dd). Needs created_to.

arrival_from.description: Arriving on or after. Needs arrival_to.

departure_from.description: Departing on or after. Needs departure_to.

offset.description: Reservations to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: wubook_list_todays_reservations
tools.title: List today's reservations
tools.description: Reservations of the property for today (arrivals, departures and stays in house). POST /kp/reservations/fetch_today_reservations.

tools.name: wubook_create_reservation
tools.title: Create reservation
tools.description: WRITE: create a reservation in ZaK for one guest. Give rooms (room type and optionally the physical room id, with price and currency) and/or products (product id with price and currency). Set assign_rooms to let ZaK pick the physical rooms. This books inventory and is NOT idempotent: calling it twice creates two reservations, so check wubook_get_room_availability first and do not retry on an error without looking the reservation up. POST /kp/reservations/new.

room.description: Physical room id (wubook_list_rooms); leave out with assign_rooms.

assign_rooms.description: Let ZaK choose physical rooms for entries without a room id.

tools.name: wubook_check_in
tools.title: Check in
tools.description: WRITE: check in the guests of a reservation in ZaK. Applies to every guest of the reservation unless room_customer_ids is given. POST /kp/reservations/do_checkin.

room_customer_ids.description: Only these reservation-room guest ids (default: all guests).

tools.name: wubook_check_out
tools.title: Check out
tools.description: WRITE: check out the guests of a reservation in ZaK. Applies to every guest of the reservation unless room_customer_ids is given. POST /kp/reservations/do_checkout.

room_customer_ids.description: Only these reservation-room guest ids (default: all guests).

tools.name: wubook_undo_check_in
tools.title: Undo check-in
tools.description: WRITE: revert the check-in of a reservation in ZaK. POST /kp/reservations/undo_checkin.

tools.name: wubook_undo_check_out
tools.title: Undo check-out
tools.description: WRITE: revert the check-out of a reservation in ZaK. POST /kp/reservations/undo_checkout.

tools.name: wubook_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer (guest)
tools.description: One guest record by customer id (from a reservation's booker or room customers): name, country, address, contact, birth data, billing info. Personal data. Identity documents (type, number, expiry) are left out unless include_documents is true. POST /kp/customers/fetch_one.

include_documents.description: Also return the guest's identity documents (default false).

prompts.title: Get started with WuBook
prompts.description: What you can do with WuBook here, with example requests to try.
